model_annotation: The diagram compares the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover across four sectors: industry, construction, trade, and other services in 2021. The three doughnut charts collectively represent four categories and show data for the total economy in absolute values and percentage terms based on NACE Rev. 2. All charts have four sectors. The "Number of Enterprises" chart has 'Other services' in blue at 61% or 19.0 million, 'Trade' in red at 19% or 5.9 million, 'Construction' in yellow at 12% or 3.7 million, and 'Industry' in brown at 8% or 2.4 million. The "Number of Persons Employed" chart has 'Other services' in blue at 51% or 80.2 million, 'Trade' in red at 21% or 33.0 million, 'Industry' in brown at 19% or 29.5 million, and 'Construction' in yellow at 9% or 13.4 million. The "Turnover" chart has 'Industry' in brown at 33% or 10.6 trillion, 'Trade' in red at 31% or 9.9 trillion, 'Other services' in blue at 31% or 9.8 trillion, and 'Construction' in yellow at 6% or 1.9 trillion. A legend below the charts indicates the color coding for each sector, and each chart includes percentage labels. The charts are arranged horizontally and are visually consistent.
